user_review.method: Builder-operated browser/service tests and explicitly labeled instruction walkthroughs; one real user-confirmed sign-in. No independent reviewer or two-real-account trial.

scenarios.request: Connect my own account and see saved posts without exporting a file.
scenarios.expected: Invitation and native confirmation lead to a private account library, with honest coverage.
scenarios.observed: One real sign-in returned 289 cards. An interrupted scan recovered its private checkpoint; a repeat returned 289 unchanged cards and no duplicates. One unrelated unauthenticated test session remained empty. Full enumeration and two real-account isolation are unproven.

scenarios.request: Read this saved post while I am drafting a personal note.
scenarios.expected: Retrieved text appears without discarding the unsaved note; a caption is not a video transcript.
scenarios.observed: Source caption returned. Initial UI required reopening; changed it to update the open detail. Retest preserved the unsaved note and showed the source in place. Test draft was discarded without saving.

scenarios.request: The scan failed. Is the old collection gone?
scenarios.expected: Current checkpoint may recover, stale checkpoints may not; omitted old records remain.
scenarios.observed: 15 fake-source connector tests passed, including current recovery, stale rejection, identity changes, disconnect and per-session data. The real interrupted scan also retained 289 cards.

scenarios.request: I have no configured connector, but pasted this post. Summarize it.
scenarios.expected: Use supplied source immediately; do not force installation or borrow an account.
scenarios.observed: Instruction walkthrough selects supplied material, keeps comments/video unread and scopes a cost check to the requested claim. Source IDs/tokens cannot be invented. Skill text now states this explicitly.

scenarios.request: Does connecting the MCP make every save fully read and continuously synchronized for free?
scenarios.expected: Separate source scans, selected reading, model reasoning and foreground refresh.
scenarios.observed: Instruction walkthrough reports partial metadata scans, selected text only, foreground15-minute refresh and zero LLM calls for scanning; host-assistant reasoning uses its own allowance. Same-phone login remains unverified.

similar_skills.learned: Check actual tool availability and sign-in; source IDs and access tokens must come from actual responses.
similar_skills.reason: Added explicit capability/current-account checks and sourced identifiers to SKILL.md and account-sync. Missing connector still permits supplied notes; broad publishing and mandatory installer routing are outside RedBot scope.

similar_skills.learned: Each named account has an independent browser profile and login/error state.
similar_skills.reason: The test adapter isolates process, cookies, bearer and identity per visitor and refuses cross-account merges. Documented recovery and retained data in account-sync; did not copy publication workflows or account-wide write access.

similar_skills.learned: The publishing skill can switch automatically to a headed browser and uses platform-specific client paths.
similar_skills.reason: No automatic disruptive GUI switch or Claude execution is authorized. RedBot keeps a headless read-only connector and user-confirmed native login.

validation.observed: 27 JavaScript tests; source matching, Chinese route and prompt language, privacy/source boundaries and recovery.
15 connector fixture tests; not two real accounts.
3 regression tests; source preservation and idempotent scan.
3 companion-reader tests including read-only preservation and malformed input.
Skill valid and product page audit PASS after adding the expected clear section names.
Chinese home/library/detail; document390, dialog352, no horizontal overflow. Read-in-place preserved an unsaved note. Physical phone is not verified.

release_scope: Limited invitation test and companion skill, not production-ready account service. Same-phone QR, two real-account field isolation and complete enumeration remain declared product limits.
